import ast,copy,gzip,hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
import yaml
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts/analysis"))
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl"))
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/".agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts"))
import assess_wheel_roa_scale as legacy
from summarize_evaluation_batch import validate_batch
from policy_evaluation_evidence import validate_evaluation_bundle
base=root/"learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0"
run="2026-09-29_21-23-15"
batch="wheel-flat-final-estvel-20260930-001"
manifest_path=base/run/"evaluations"/batch/"manifest.json"
manifest=validate_batch(manifest_path)
assert len(manifest["cases"])==6 and all(c["status"]=="completed" for c in manifest["cases"])
old_path=legacy.OLD_CLOSED
old=json.loads(old_path.read_bytes())
kernel=old["analysis_source"]["python"]
assert hashlib.sha256(kernel.encode()).hexdigest()==old["analysis_source"]["sha256"]
node=next(n for n in ast.parse(kernel).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=="analyze")
source=ast.get_source_segment(kernel,node)
source=legacy.replace_once(source,"def analyze(result_path):","def analyze(result_path, action_scale):")
source=legacy.replace_once(source,"target=a*np.array([.25]*8+[1]*2)","target=a*np.asarray(action_scale)")
source=legacy.replace_once(source,"  result['stages'][name]=xx","  if len(ix)==hi-lo:\n   jp=arr('joint_position')[ix][:,h]\n   band=spectral_band_rms(jp,5)\n   xx['hip_position_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad']=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(band**2)))\n  result['stages'][name]=xx")
ns={"Path":pathlib.Path,"json":json,"gzip":gzip,"np":np,"ref":legacy.ref,"old":old,"joint_order":legacy.JOINT_ORDER}
exec(compile(source,"<verified-archived-stage-analysis>","exec"),ns)
env=yaml.load((root/"logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa"/run/"params/env.yaml").read_text(),Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
scale=legacy.resolve_scale(env)
assert scale.tolist()==[.125,.125]+[.25]*6+[1.,1.]
historical_paths={
 "ROA_0923_final":old_path,
 "ROA_0926_final":base/"2026-09-26_11-37-09/evidence/analysis/flat-roa-scale-assess-20260928-001/metrics.json",
 "ROA_0928_no_velocity":base/"2026-09-28_17-06-19/evidence/analysis/wheel-flat-no-velocity-assess-20260929-001/metrics.json"}
historical={k:json.loads(p.read_bytes()) for k,p in historical_paths.items()}
for k,p in historical_paths.items():assert p.is_file() and legacy.sha(p)==legacy.ref(p)["sha256"]
cases={};comparisons={};keys=("tracking_xy_rmse_m_s","tracking_yaw_rmse_rad_s","hip_target_step_rms_rad","hip_velocity_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad_s","body_roll_pitch_angvel_rms_rad_s","net_xy_displacement_m","hip_position_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad")
for entry in manifest["cases"]:
 scenario=entry["scenario"]["scenario_id"]
 current=ns["analyze"](pathlib.Path(entry["result"]["path"]),scale)
 assert current["telemetry_status"]=="complete" and not current["done_steps"] and not current["timeout_steps"]
 cases[scenario]=current
 comparisons[scenario]={}
 for label,data in historical.items():
  key=("2026-09-23_17-23-24/"+scenario) if label=="ROA_0923_final" else scenario
  prior=data["cases"].get(key)
  if prior is None:
   comparisons[scenario][label]={"available":False}
   continue
  assert prior["scenario"]==current["scenario"],(scenario,label)
  assert validate_evaluation_bundle(legacy.read_ref(prior["result"]))["status"]=="valid"
  assert legacy.read_ref(prior["telemetry"]).is_file()
  changes={}
  for stage,new in current["stages"].items():
   oldstage=prior["stages"][stage]
   changes[stage]={k:{"new":new[k],"old":oldstage.get(k),"change_percent":(new[k]/oldstage[k]-1)*100 if oldstage.get(k) not in (None,0) and new.get(k) is not None else None} for k in keys if isinstance(new.get(k),(int,float)) and isinstance(oldstage.get(k),(int,float))}
  comparisons[scenario][label]={"available":True,"scenario_contract_equal":True,"stages":changes,"historical_result":prior["result"]}
out=base/run/"evidence/analysis/final-model49999-batch-20260930-001"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
scenarios=[c["scenario"]["scenario_id"] for c in manifest["cases"][:4]]
labels=list(historical)+["ROA_0929_final"]
metric_names=[("hip_target_step_rms_rad","Hip target step RMS (rad)"),("hip_velocity_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad_s","Hip velocity 5-25 Hz RMS (rad/s)"),("body_roll_pitch_angvel_rms_rad_s","Body roll/pitch rate RMS (rad/s)"),("tracking_yaw_rmse_rad_s","Yaw tracking RMSE (rad/s)")]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9),constrained_layout=True)
for axis,(metric,title) in zip(axes.flat,metric_names):
 for j,label in enumerate(labels):
  data=cases if label=="ROA_0929_final" else historical[label]["cases"]
  values=[]
  for scenario in scenarios:
   key=("2026-09-23_17-23-24/"+scenario) if label=="ROA_0923_final" else scenario
   values.append(data[key]["stages"]["turn_steady_42_70s"][metric])
  axis.bar(np.arange(4)+(j-1.5)*.19,values,.19,label=label)
 axis.set_xticks(range(4),[s.replace("-noise","") for s in scenarios],rotation=15)
 axis.set_ylabel(title);axis.grid(axis="y",alpha=.2)
axes[0,0].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle("Matched Native scenarios, turn 42-70s | Sep29 final newly tested; older results reused")
plot=out/"comparison.png";fig.savefig(plot,dpi=150);plt.close(fig)
static=base/run/"evidence/analysis/static-rightturn-model49999-20260930-001/metrics.json"
mid=base/run/"evidence/analysis/static-rightturn-model29000-20260930-001/metrics.json"
mid_prefix_path=base/run/"evidence/analysis/closed-loop-prefix-model29000-20260930-001/metrics.json"
mid_prefix=json.loads(mid_prefix_path.read_bytes())
right_telemetry=pathlib.Path(cases["right-delay15-noise"]["telemetry"]["path"])
right_samples=json.loads(gzip.decompress(right_telemetry.read_bytes()))["samples"]
matched_prefix={}
for name,(lo,hi) in {"standing_1_10s":(50,500),"straight_11_40s":(550,2000)}.items():
 samples=right_samples[lo:hi]
 v=np.array([s["root_linear_velocity_b"] for s in samples],dtype=float)
 cmd=np.array([s["command"] for s in samples],dtype=float)
 pos=np.array([s["root_position_w"] for s in samples],dtype=float)
 target=np.array([s["action"][:2] for s in samples],dtype=float)*.125
 current={"mean_body_vx_m_s":float(v[:,0].mean()),"net_xy_displacement_m":float(np.linalg.norm(pos[-1,:2]-pos[0,:2])),"tracking_xy_rmse_m_s":float(np.sqrt(np.mean((v[:,:2]-cmd[:,:2])**2))),"hip_target_step_rms_rad":float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.diff(target,axis=0)**2)))}
 old_values=mid_prefix["current_windows"][name]
 matched_prefix[name]={"final":current,"mid_model29000":{k:old_values[k] for k in current},"exact_step_window_half_open":[lo,hi]}
result={"version":1,"created_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"analysis_kind":"final_checkpoint_closed_loop_comparison","new_model":"ROA_0929_final_model49999","batch":legacy.ref(manifest_path),"checkpoint":legacy.ref(root/"logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa"/run/"model_49999.pt"),"cases":cases,"historical_analyses":{k:legacy.ref(p) for k,p in historical_paths.items()},"historical_policy_inference_count":0,"comparisons":comparisons,"method":{"archived_analysis":legacy.ref(old_path),"analysis_kernel_sha256":hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),"new_action_scale":scale.tolist(),"step_dt_seconds":.02,"sample_stride":1,"turn_stages_half_open_steps":old["method"]["turn_stages_half_open_steps"],"historical_metrics_reused":True,"matching_scenario_contract_required":True,"one_seed":42,"one_environment":1},"artifacts":{"plot":legacy.ref(plot)},"static_analysis":legacy.ref(static),"mid_checkpoint_static_analysis":legacy.ref(mid),"mid_checkpoint_prefix_analysis":legacy.ref(mid_prefix_path),"matched_prefix_comparison":matched_prefix,"analysis_source":{"python":DRIVER_SOURCE,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(DRIVER_SOURCE.encode()).hexdigest()},"assessment":{"convergence":"indeterminate","reason":"No approved convergence or acceptance thresholds"},"limitations":["One seed and one simulated environment per scenario; no current-policy hardware trial.","30 ms delay is outside the trained 0-15 ms actuator delay range.","Physical hip targets precede actuator buffering; static old-hardware replay retains the old policy action history.","Training configurations changed together, so comparisons are not causal ablations."],"direct_parameter_change_supported":False,"policy_description_required":"仅可进入受监督实物测试；未经实物验证，不代表 hardware-ready。"}
legacy.write_json(out/"metrics.json",result)
print(json.dumps({"metrics":legacy.ref(out/"metrics.json"),"plot":legacy.ref(plot),"cases":len(cases),"all_no_done":all(not c["done_steps"] for c in cases.values()),"turn":{s:{k:round(cases[s]["stages"]["turn_steady_42_70s"][k],4) for k in ("hip_target_step_rms_rad","hip_velocity_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad_s","tracking_yaw_rmse_rad_s")} for s in scenarios}},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)

assessment.reason: No approved convergence or acceptance thresholds

limitations: One seed and one simulated environment per scenario; no current-policy hardware trial.
30 ms delay is outside the trained 0-15 ms actuator delay range.
Physical hip targets precede actuator buffering; static old-hardware replay retains the old policy action history.
Training configurations changed together, so comparisons are not causal ablations.
policy_description_required: 仅可进入受监督实物测试；未经实物验证，不代表 hardware-ready。
